description: This file contains API service functions for a web UI, including data fetching, mock data generation, and API request handling for various system components like WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, NTP, Ddns, QoS, and system status.

methods.name: getWanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WAN status, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getLanStatus
methods.description: Fetches LAN status, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getWlanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WLAN status, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Fetches system statistics, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Fetches Wi-Fi neighbor info, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: scanWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Scans for Wi-Fi neighbors on specified band, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getLcmStatus
methods.description: Fetches LCM status, returns mock deployment units in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getNtpSettings
methods.description: Retrieves NTP configuration, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: updateNtpSettings
methods.description: Updates NTP configuration, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Retrieves timezone data, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: updateTimezone
methods.description: Updates timezone settings, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getDdns
methods.description: Retrieves DDNS configuration, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: updateDdns
methods.description: Updates DDNS settings, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getDualImageStatus
methods.description: Fetches dual image status, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getQosBandwidth
methods.description: Retrieves QoS bandwidth settings, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: updateQosBandwidth
methods.description: Updates QoS bandwidth configuration, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: getQosRule
methods.description: Fetches QoS rules, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.

methods.name: updateQosRule
methods.description: Updates QoS rules, returns mock data in development mode or calls API otherwise.
